BLOCK · DRAW

Table rules

Match the open ends, empty your hand, and turn every tile into a little table drama. Play solo against the computer or pass the phone to a friend.

  • Each player draws seven from a double-six set. On the first hand, the highest double leads. If nobody has a double, reshuffle.
  • Match either open end. Doubles sit across the line, and the line turns when it reaches the table edge.
  • Block: if you cannot play, pass. Draw: draw until you can play or only two tiles remain in the boneyard.
  • Play your last tile and call “Domino!” The winner scores every pip left in the other hand.
  • If both players are blocked, lowest pip total wins the hand and scores the opponent’s remaining pips. A tie scores nothing.
  • The first player to the chosen target wins the match.
